tools.name: aura_coverage
tools.description: Which sports, seasons and data products Aura has right now, with measured completeness and freshness. Call when unsure whether Aura covers something.

tools.name: aura_list_games
tools.description: Games for one day with teams, start time, status and score. Omit date for today (US Pacific league date). Filter by sport, status or team abbreviation. Returns Aura game ids for the other game tools; for odds, pass each id to aura_game_markets.

tools.name: aura_live_games
tools.description: Every game in progress right now, across all sports, with score and period or inning.

tools.name: aura_get_game
tools.description: One game by Aura game id: teams, start time, status, period and score.

tools.name: aura_game_frame
tools.description: What is happening in a game at this moment: score, situation (count, outs and bases, or period and clock), latest play and freshness.

tools.name: aura_game_markets
tools.description: Current odds for one game: moneyline, spread, total and player props, each source priced on both sides, with live result and settlement. Pass marketType to keep the result small; player_prop results can be large, so add playerId or definitionId.

tools.name: aura_odds_timeline
tools.description: How a game's odds moved from open to now, as timestamped observations. Use for "how has the line moved".

tools.name: aura_boxscore
tools.description: Full box score for one game: team totals and every player's stat line.

tools.name: aura_game_plays
tools.description: Play-by-play for one game in order, a page at a time. Pass page.nextCursor to continue.

tools.name: aura_metric_series
tools.description: Time series of in-game metrics for one game, such as win probability, score margin and player lines. Call without definitionId first to see which series exist.

tools.name: aura_list_teams
tools.description: Every team in a sport with Aura team ids, names, abbreviations, colors, conference and division.

tools.name: aura_get_team
tools.description: One team by Aura team id.

tools.name: aura_get_team_roster
tools.description: A team's roster with player ids, positions, jersey numbers, height, weight and headshots.

tools.name: aura_list_players
tools.description: Player profiles for a whole sport, a page at a time. For one team use aura_get_team_roster.

tools.name: aura_get_player
tools.description: One player by Aura player id: name, position, status, current team and headshot.

tools.name: aura_claim_email
tools.description: Emails the user a 6-digit code that moves this connection from the trial to the free plan (50,000 requests a month). Ask the user for their email first; never guess it. Then ask them for the code and call aura_verify_email.

tools.name: aura_verify_email
tools.description: Checks the 6-digit code from the user's email and puts this connection on the free plan: 50,000 requests a month.

tools.name: aura_upgrade
tools.description: Returns a checkout link for Aura Pro: $20 a month for 500,000 requests. Give the link to the user; they pay in their browser and this connection upgrades. Needs a verified email first.
